description: STATED LIMIT, not a defence (§13.1, §18). An account with no home: the honest history removes the passkey at seq 3 and carries on to seq 4, and every activation is final at once. The passkey, a former controller, signs a late entry at seq 2 and a `resolve` keeping it; with no home there is no receipt, no delay and no witness of time or order, so a new verifier gets the late branch (the passkey is a controller again) and nothing in the objects tells the two histories apart. A verifier with persisted state reports rollback, and a host MUST refuse and show it. Accounts need a home.
